scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.
programs: 6 plateau genomes, their xor1 / xor15 witnesses, crossed organisms of P-J03 / P-J06 if any
readout: nearest P-F02 shape and L1 distance; moved = shape changes or distance to the parent's curve > .3
material_rule: material if a witness or crossed organism changes shape relative to its parent in >= half the pairs
